measurementMethod.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 6.1.1-3ubuntu5 Copyright (c) 2000-2023 the FFmpeg developers
measurementMethod.video: FFprobe decoded frame timestamps and counts, separately from container duration; median positive interframe interval determines final-frame end.
measurementMethod.audio: FFmpeg decodes first audio channel at 48000 Hz; exact 0.3-second windows use 2*abs(sum(sample*exp(-2*pi*i*frequency*t)))/sampleCount. No downmix gain normalization.
measurementMethod.lateFrame: One frame decoded at 2.1 seconds and downscaled to one RGB pixel; verifies a nonblack late frame exists, not full image fidelity.

assessment.audioPitchGainExcerpt: All three independently decoded windows preserve the original 440 Hz near 0.1 amplitude and independent 660 Hz near 0.2. Shifted or outside-excerpt tones remain below 0.000005.
assessment.durationAndCoverage: Video has 135 complete 360x640 frames from 0 to 2.233333 seconds, ending at 2.25 seconds. AAC track ends at 2.295011 seconds, within the unchanged 120 ms tolerance.
assessment.cadenceFailure: Decoded video is 60 fps, despite production explicitly configuring frameDuration=1/30. This violates the intended 30 fps output cap confirmed by the parent; audio and coverage success do not make the failed expanded suite pass.
assessment.likelyMechanism: Inference from Apple documented source-track timing precedence and actual 2x output: the Core Image composition retains the speed-scaled source cadence because production never clears sourceTrackIDForFrameTiming.
assessment.recommendedRepair: Explicitly clear sourceTrackIDForFrameTiming with kCMPersistentTrackID_Invalid before setting frameDuration=1/30; retain strict 30 fps frame count and spacing, decoded PCM/video coverage, pitch/gain/excerpt and late-frame assertions.
assessment.verificationRequired: New exact-source Swift compile and all eight runtime cases must pass before accepting this production repair.
